title: feature_state_changed event payload
$comment: Provenance (WU 2.14, F2.4): authored 2026-04-23 in WU 2.9; closes findings F1.1 + F2.9. Fields: from_state (required, enum), to_state (required, enum), trigger (required, freeform string). The event_type itself was also added to event.schema.json enum in WU 2.9. Next-step addition (2026-06-08, PM v1.9.2): optional `next_step` snapshot — the next_step block the `/initiative-status` skill just wrote (or removed) on the registry, recorded here so the event log carries both *what* state was entered and *what action* was chosen at entry time. Omitted on transitions to terminal/pre-planning states (where the registry has no next_step) and on legacy events emitted before this addition. Schema mirrors `feature-frontmatter.schema.json` $defs would mirror, but kept inline (no $ref) to keep this event payload self-contained.
description: Payload shape for the `feature_state_changed` event emitted by the PM agent (and, for the `plan_review → generating` transition, indirectly on behalf of the human approval gate) on every feature-level state transition the PM agent owns. Feature state vocabulary mirrors `shared/schemas/feature-frontmatter.schema.json` §state enum — the canonical machine-readable source. Added in Phase 2 WU 2.9 to close the event-log gap surfaced in findings F1.1 and F2.9.

from_state.description: Feature state before the transition. Must be a value from the feature state machine in `state-vocabulary.md` and `feature-frontmatter.schema.json`.

to_state.description: Feature state after the transition. Must be a value from the feature state machine in `state-vocabulary.md` and `feature-frontmatter.schema.json`.

trigger.description: Names the action or event that caused this state transition. Freeform string at v1; examples: `plan_ready`, `plan_approved`, `first_round_issues_opened`, `all_tasks_done`, `human_escalation:spec_level_blocker`. Future versions may constrain this to a closed enum per-transition pair.

next_step.description: Snapshot of the next_step block written to the registry at this transition. Present only when to_state requires next_step per `feature-frontmatter.schema.json` root allOf (planning / plan_review / generating / in_progress / blocked). Absent on transitions to terminal (done/abandoned) or pre-planning (drafting/validating) states — in those cases the registry's next_step was removed and there is nothing to snapshot. Schema mirrors `feature-frontmatter.schema.json` $defs.next_step (inline rather than $ref to keep payload self-contained).
